ideas.pitch: A voice-first macOS and web desktop agent that intercepts and analyzes phone calls and messages in real time to protect seniors from digital scams and phishing.
ideas.title: ElderGuard Voice Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven agentic AI architecture from previous agent hackathon winners, directly addressing a massive social security vulnerability that appeals heavily to judges looking for real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent auditing system that reviews automated local government welfare and scheme allocations to detect and correct demographic algorithmic bias.
ideas.title: AuditFair AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the GovTech track with a sophisticated multi-agent governance pipeline, echoing award-winning bias evaluation frameworks.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration for regional hospitals to safely route clinical data to localized AI diagnostic tools without violating patient privacy.
ideas.title: MedClaim MCP Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge distributed protocol design (MCP) with healthcare infrastructure, delivering the deep technical engineering that hackathon judges reward.

ideas.pitch: A GPS-enabled local economy booster that rewards citizens with redeemable tokens for walking to neighborhood small businesses while generating live foot-traffic analytics for municipal councils.
ideas.title: CivicWalk Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a multi-award-winning civic tech concept into a localized execution for Indian municipal commerce, offering an immediately demonstrable mobile-web hybrid product.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI hardware prototype utilizing a camera and microcontroller to automatically segregate agricultural waste and plastics on farm processing conveyor belts.
ideas.title: AgriVision TrashSort
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware and AI to solve an urgent sustainability problem, matching patterns from successful hardware and robotics hackathon winners.
